kinds.d: Water pipe with a bowl, body, water base and one or more hoses, for shisha.

x.d: Water pipe called shisha in Egypt, Sudan and much of the Arab world; Levant form is arjīlah.
Nargile as used in Turkey and the Balkans.
Ghalyan of Persian-speaking countries; earliest known literary reference is from the poet Ahlī Shirazi, died 1535.
Huqqa of the Indian subcontinent; the hookah is credited by one account to Abul-Fath Gilani at the Mughal court.
Los Angeles-based Kaloud's heat-management system, tested by commissioned German laboratory work.

kinds.d: Moist, usually flavoured tobacco for smoking in a hookah, mixed with molasses, glycerol and flavouring.

x.d: Sweetened tobacco mix of molasses, vegetable glycerol and flavourings, developed in Egypt in the early 20th century.
Lebanon-based flavoured shisha maker founded 1999, common on American café menus.

kinds.d: Unflavoured, coarse tobacco burned directly with charcoal in rural South Asian and Persian-Turkish water pipes.
Shisha of non-tobacco material, sold with the hookah products it imitates.

x.d: Porous mineral stones that absorb vegetable glycerol and flavouring and release vapour when heated; German brand.

brands.d: Los Angeles hookah systems company behind the Krysalis.
Lebanon-based flavoured shisha tobacco maker owned by AIR Global.
Egyptian shisha tobacco maker, also known as Al-Nakhla.
German maker of steam stones, the first of their kind.

traditions.d: Water-pipe smoking of sweetened muʽassel tobacco, called shisha in Egypt and arjīlah in the Levant.
traditions.auth: Sealed packs from named makers such as Al Fakher and Nakhla.

traditions.d: Persian water pipe, with literary reference by Ahlī Shirazi before 1535 and a court post of hookah tender.
traditions.mat: Glass and precious metals for the rich

traditions.d: Indian water pipe; Koyilandy (Malabar) hookahs were an export style.

notes: Khalil Mamoon, Alpha Hookah, Maklaud, Steamulation, Dschinni, Aladin, Starbuzz, Afzal, Fumari, Tangiers, Adalya, Darkside, MustHave and Bidriware not on retrieved pages; omitted. Shiazo is the only tobacco-free brand sourced. Hookah.com is the old source for two kinds.
